application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
REAR GARDEN		

T1	Narrowleaf Firethorn (Pyracantha angustifolia)	Reduce height only by approximately 2-3m to allow more light into the garden while still maintaining adequate screening. Final height = 3m and final spread = 2m.	

FRONT GARDEN	

T2	Tree Of Heaven (Alianthus altissima)	Crown reduce by approximately 3m back to most recent previous reduction points to tidy and contain.
        Final height = 10m and final spread = 5m.	

T3	Sycamore (Acer pseudoplatanus)	Crown reduce by approximately 2-3m back to most recent previous reduction points to tidy and contain.
        Final height = 12m and final spread = 6m.	
	
T5	Holm Oak - Evergreen Oak (Quercus ilex)	Reduce height by approximately 2-3m and trim all round to tidy and shape, including neighbours side.
        Final height = 2m and final spread = 3m.	

T6	Holly (Ilex aquifolium)	Trim all round to tidy and shape. Final height = 4m and final spread = 2m.
